description: CsNa₂Fe₃P₄O₁₄Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Cs is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to twelve O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.21-3.65 Å. Both Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.49 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.68 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.21 Å. The Fe-Cl bond length is 2.91 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.52 Å) and one longer (2.78 Å) Fe-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.63 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cs and two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Fe and one P atom. Cl is bonded to two equivalent Cs and four Fe atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClCs₂Fe₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
